format: terrain[row][col] = terrain type id per 48x48 cell (Hexzmap.e5 entry: byte W*3, byte H*3, W*H bytes row-major); image = JPEG of W*48 x H*48 pixels (opaque, no palette)
source: Hexzmap.e5 (Ls12, 126 entries; loader 0x44c1c2: entry = word 0x510cfe, stores W,H at 0x4b422c) + MAP/mNNN.jpg (name built by 0x463d4f "MAP\\M%s.Jpg" with the 3-digit map id, loaded by 0x420bae(word 0x510cfe) from battle setup 0x44d386)
map_id: word 0x510cfe, set by the scene op 0x413d13 kind 3: a4 (0xffff -> 99) + 100*byte[0x505f4c]

maps.note: no MAP/m109.jpg in the game (Hexzmap entry without picture)
